# freshdesk_role (Data Source)

Look up a single agent role by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_role" "example" {
  # Singular data sources take the record ID.
  # id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the role to look up.

### Read-Only

- `agent_type` (Number) Agent kind the role applies to.
- `created_at` (String) When the role was created (RFC 3339).
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is a built-in role.
- `description` (String) What the role permits.
- `name` (String) Name of the role.
- `updated_at` (String) When the role was last changed (RFC 3339).
